svg.title: kv-cross-layer
svg.desc: Which layers own a KV cache. CLA2 in Hunyuan-Large: 64 layers, every second layer reuses its neighbour, 32 caches, with GQA-8 about 5% of MHA (reported 95% saved). Gemma 3n E4B: 35 layers, layers 20 to 34 reuse layer 18 (local) or 19 (global): 20 caches, growing cache 14 to 8 KiB per token. Gemma 4 E2B: layers 15 to 34 reuse layers 13 and 14: 15 caches, 14 to 6 KiB per token. YOCO: a self-decoder with window caches, then one global KV read by every cross-decoder layer; reported about 80 times less KV at 65B.

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif
STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: bytes / token = Σℓ ∈ owners 2Hkv dh s
cross-decoder: every layer cross-attends to one global KV
prefill exit: layers above never produce KV, so prompt tokens can stop here (YOCO 2.87× prefill at 32K; Gemma 3n 2× vs Gemma 3 4B, reported)
